Generate a Supervised-Service Template for the Collector

Source: R/collect.R
rt2s_service_template.Rd

Emits a ready-to-edit service definition that keeps rt2s_collect running unattended: a systemd unit, a launchd plist, a cron @reboot line, or a Dockerfile.

Usage

rt2s_service_template(
  type = c("systemd", "launchd", "cron", "docker"),
  config_path = "/etc/gtfsrt2static/feeds.csv",
  dir = "/var/lib/gtfsrt-archive"
)

Arguments

type

One of "systemd", "launchd", "cron", "docker".

config_path

Path to an R script or RDS/CSV holding the feeds config; referenced in the generated command.

dir

Archive root directory used in the generated command.

Value

The template as a character scalar (also printed with cat() for copy-pasting).
